run_yolo_world_service: run the YOLO-World ZMQ server on port 21001 for object detection requests
send_detection_request: send an image and query classes via ZMQ to the YOLO-World detection service
set_yolo_classes: call model.set_classes with a list of query classes before running prediction
predict_with_yolo_world: run model.predict on an image using CUDA to get bounding boxes and confidence scores
visualize_yolo_results: use r.plot to draw detected bounding boxes on the input image
